subject: Renewal paperwork & order form redlines — capacity uplift coordination
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Geller <alex.geller@finity.com>, Finity Procurement <procurement@finity.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal paperwork & order form redlines — capacity uplift coordination

Hi Alex / procurement team,

Thanks again for the productive call last week. As discussed, Finity is moving forward with the 18-month renewal and the proposed capacity uplift (additional 3 dedicated instances + higher throughput for burst windows). Attached are two files: a redlined order form with the capacity line item (Finity_orderform_v2_redlines.pdf) and a tracked-changes cut of the proposed MSA edits (MSA_TrkChanges_20261118.docx).

Key asks from our side:
- Please confirm the final total committed capacity so we can calculate the ramp schedule.
- Procurement: can you confirm the acceptance timeline for the updated order form and whether procurement needs any PO fields before we send DocuSign?
- Legal: if there are any MSA clauses you cannot accept as written, call them out and we can propose alternate language.

I cc'd Kimberly (sales ops) to handle billing/pricing questions and Lauren from Customer Success for the rollout plan. I expect a few small commercial tweaks, and potentially one insurance/indemnity clarification based on Finity internal policy.

Next step: if you can return a single annotated PDF with comments by EOD Wednesday (Nov 18) we can get legal to finalize and generate a DocuSign envelope.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Principal Account Executive
Redwood Inference
attachments: Finity_orderform_v2_redlines.pdf (order form, pdf stub); MSA_TrkChanges_20261118.docx (tracked changes, docx stub)
From: Alex Geller <alex.geller@finity.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Finity Procurement <procurement@finity.com>, Dana Morris <dana.morris@finity.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork & order form redlines — capacity uplift coordination

Jordan — thanks for sending these over. Quick read-through and initial feedback from procurement below: 

- Order form: overall looks good, but we need the PO number field and billing contact name added to the first page (we typically insert PO before signature). Can your ops team include a PO field?
- Pricing: the burst unit price in the redline looks higher than our expectation from the call (we'd budgeted the mid-tier burst rate). Can Kimberly confirm final per-burst token price?
- MSA: legal flagged Section 7.4 (data residency carve) and Section 12 (indemnity caps). We need proposed alternative language on indemnity — internal counsel is unlikely to accept broad liability language.

We can get an annotated PDF back by EOD Thursday (Nov 19). We do require a procurement checklist attached when sharing for signature — I will attach our standard checklist in my next reply.

— Alex
Head of Cloud Platform, Finity
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Geller <alex.geller@finity.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork & order form redlines — capacity uplift coordination

Alex — good to connect. A few quick notes on pricing and the PO field:

- We can add a PO number placeholder on the order form front page and a billing contact line. I'll attach a one-page update after lunch.
- On burst pricing: Jordan and I validated the model — the redline reflects the mid-tier burst rate discussed, but the per-token rounding differs slightly after the reserved capacity credit was applied. I'll send a short spreadsheet showing the math for transparency.

Markus (legal) — procurement mentioned concerns on indemnity and data residency. Can you review Sections 7.4 and 12 in the attached tracked-changes doc and propose language that is likely to be acceptable to Finity while preserving our core protections? If there is a counter-proposal, please inline it in the doc so I can share with Alex.

Thanks — Kimberly
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Alex Geller <alex.geller@finity.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork & order form redlines — capacity uplift coordination

Kimberly / Jordan / Alex — I reviewed the tracked-changes doc. High level: we can accept a constrained alternative on indemnity that limits Redwood's exposure to direct damages and excludes consequential damages, and we can offer a mutual carve for data residency so long as Finity provides an acceptable attestation of compliance controls.

Proposed edits (inline summary):
- Section 7.4 (Data residency): add a subclause that requires customer to use region-specific endpoints and acknowledges that certain ancillary services may process metadata outside the region. Also include an audit-rights/timebox for any requested data export.
- Section 12 (Indemnity): replace the broad 'no cap' phrase with a negotiated cap equivalent to the 12-month fees in the order form, and explicitly exclude indirect/consequential damages.

I'll attach MSA_TrkChanges_20261118_v2.docx with the inline edits and brief commentary. Alex — if those changes are acceptable, we can lock the commercial terms and I'll approve generating the DocuSign envelope. If you prefer a different cap, propose a number and we can loop finance.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference
attachments: MSA_TrkChanges_20261118_v2.docx (legal edits, docx stub)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Geller <alex.geller@finity.com>, Finity Procurement <procurement@finity.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork & order form redlines — capacity uplift coordination

Alex / procurement team — appreciate the fast turnaround. Attached are: the updated order form with a PO field (Finity_orderform_v2_redlines.pdf, v2) and Markus's updated MSA with the indemnity/data residency edits (MSA_TrkChanges_20261118_v2.docx).

Next steps:
1) Alex — please confirm the PO number and the billing contact line and return an annotated PDF if anything else needs to change.
2) If legal language looks acceptable, I will request Finance to prepare the billing table and issue the DocuSign envelope by Monday (Nov 23).
3) Lauren will follow up on the rollout schedule and kick off the onboarding to align the capacity ramp (she will reach out separately).

If procurement needs our standard compliance evidence package (SOC2 report, retention policies), we can attach those to the DocuSign or share a Drive link; let me know which you prefer.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this week so we can start the uplift next month.

Jordan Blake
Principal Account Executive
Redwood Inference
attachments: Finity_orderform_v2_redlines.pdf (updated order form, pdf stub); MSA_TrkChanges_20261118_v2.docx (legal edits, docx stub)
